advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: We don't do any regulations. We just do paper, rolling paper.
advice_items.summary_en: Pick an ancillary, unregulated niche (rolling papers) within a booming industry (cannabis).
advice_items.summary_zh: 切入无监管细分市场卖卷烟纸

advice_items.quote: Work hard and you can do whatever you want.
advice_items.summary_en: Consistent hard work makes anything possible, especially in America.
advice_items.summary_zh: 秉持坚韧精神全力努力工作

advice_items.quote: Connect yourself with good people, and that's hard to find these days... trustworthy people, happy people.
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with trustworthy, positive, high-character people.
advice_items.summary_zh: 结交诚实可靠积极的优质人脉

advice_items.quote: have discipline, wake up in the morning, work hard. I came from boxing and became the world champion. Takes a lot of discipline.
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain strict daily discipline, wake up early, and stay sober.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持高度自律早起并保持清醒

guests.first_money_or_break: 来自荷兰阿姆斯特丹，曾是职业拳击世界冠军；移居美国后切入大麻产业链中不受监管的细分市场，创立卷烟纸品牌 Futurama 并经营14年，年营收达1000万至1亿美元。
guests.role_or_title: Founder of Futurama (Rolling Paper Brand) & Former World Champion Boxer
guests.zero_start_advice: 保持清醒和自律，每天早起努力工作，并与值得信赖、积极乐观的优秀人才建立联系。

advice_items.quote: Hustle hustle hustle, grind grind grind. Lift others while you excel.
advice_items.summary_en: Outwork everyone relentlessly while lifting others up along the way.
advice_items.summary_zh: 持续拼搏并在成功时提携他人

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: Real estate and the defense industry... as long as there enemies, there going to be wars.
advice_items.summary_en: Operate in durable, enduring sectors such as real estate and defense.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选择刚需长青的房地产与国防赛道

advice_items.quote: First, you have to follow before you can lead. You learn something from everyone you encounter.
advice_items.summary_en: Learn how to follow first and extract lessons from everyone you meet before leading.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先学会追随并向每个人虚心学习

advice_items.quote: education, whether it's content education or the weapons industry education, grow, learn, and excel at that, and it opens doors.
advice_items.summary_en: Invest in domain education and keep growing and learning to unlock opportunities.
advice_items.summary_zh: 通过专业教育与持续学习打开大门

advice_items.quote: Haters fuel. If they're not hating, you're not doing anything.
advice_items.summary_en: Use critics and doubters as fuel rather than letting them stop you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把质疑与嘲讽化作前进的燃料

advice_items.quote: Adaptability. Technology has changed the landscape... If we can't do that or trust and embrace folks like you who can, then we're going to get left behind.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay adaptable and embrace emerging technologies like AI or risk being left behind.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持适应力并主动拥抱AI新技术

advice_items.quote: Content is changing everything. ... You evolve or you become yesterday's news.
advice_items.summary_en: Create content consistently to stay relevant in modern business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 必须创作内容否则将被时代淘汰

advice_items.quote: I put God before everything else. God, faith, family.
advice_items.summary_en: Keep God, faith, and family ahead of business and wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把信仰和家庭置于金钱之上

advice_items.quote: To win without fighting is best. Sun Tzu.
advice_items.summary_en: Apply Sun Tzu's principle of winning strategically without unnecessary conflict.
advice_items.summary_zh: 借鉴孙子兵法追求不战而胜

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身克利夫兰赤贫家庭，凭借奖学金考入伊萨卡学院并服役美国海军陆战队；退役后进入房地产、国防工业及退伍军人创意内容领域。
guests.guest_name: Beverly Hills Marine Veteran & Defense/Real Estate Entrepreneur
guests.role_or_title: Real Estate & Defense Industry Entrepreneur / Marine Corps Veteran
guests.zero_start_advice: 先学会追随再领导，向遇到的每个人学习；重视专业教育与持续成长，拥抱AI与内容创作等新技术，并坚定信仰与格局。

advice_items.quote: Cash. Just remember one thing. Cash is king, queen, jack, and everything else.
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize cash flow above everything else when scaling a business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 经营企业时刻牢记现金为王

advice_items.quote: You feel it in your heart and you intellectualize with your head. You study.
advice_items.summary_en: Ground your faith through both heartfelt conviction and disciplined study.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用心感受并以理性钻研坚定信仰

advice_items.quote: If you have an idea and you think that someone is not doing an idea that you think you can do, go for it.
advice_items.summary_en: Location doesn't matter—if you spot an unserved idea you can execute, act on it immediately.
advice_items.summary_zh: 有别人未做的想法就立即行动

guests.first_money_or_break: 1970年5月与四位合伙人共同创立面向黑人女性的《Essence》杂志，发展至约300名员工的九位数规模企业，最终出售给时代华纳（Time Warner）。
guests.role_or_title: Co-Founder of Essence Magazine (Sold to Time Warner)
guests.zero_start_advice: 现金为王（Cash is king）；只要看到别人没在做而你能实现的想法，不必纠结所在城市，立刻放手去做。

advice_items.quote: what do you want in life? I said, love and affection. If you don't have that, I don't care how much money you've got, you don't want to enjoy it.
advice_items.summary_en: Money cannot be enjoyed without love and affection in your life.
advice_items.summary_zh: 爱与情感比金钱更重要否则难享财富

advice_items.quote: some people make money and they don't spend it because they're afraid. They don't like to take the risk. They want a paycheck.
advice_items.summary_en: Don't hoard cash in a bank out of fear—you have to put capital at risk to build real wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 克服恐惧敢于投资与承担风险

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: I want to pay myself what I think I should earn. I don't want to work for anybody.
advice_items.summary_en: Work for yourself rather than someone else, because employment caps your upside.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不要替人打工而要自己创业致富

advice_items.quote: It keeps you out there wanting looking at the sky and saying, 'Look at that. I can do this.'
advice_items.summary_en: Keep your ambition high and stay hungry to build and improve every day.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持野心与自信相信自己能做到

advice_items.quote: Always do it right. Being honest makes you money. Not being honest... destroys your life. Just be honest, be kind and be loving.
advice_items.summary_en: Always act with honesty, kindness, and integrity—cutting corners destroys your life.
advice_items.summary_zh: 做人做事诚实善良才能长久赚钱

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Wait Too Long to Start / Invest
advice_items.quote: So don't wait too long starting now because you're already getting old because when you get into your 30s and your 40s, it slides down the hill. So do it.
advice_items.summary_en: Life moves fast—start now while young instead of waiting until your 30s or 40s.
advice_items.summary_zh: 趁年轻立刻行动别等老了再后悔

guests.first_money_or_break: 29岁时带着孩子来到加州白手起家，主营烟草行业并拥有多家保密企业，最终成为坐拥3500万美元豪宅及多辆顶级豪车的亿万富翁。
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要因害怕风险而把钱死存银行，要敢于为自己打工而不是替别人打工；始终保持诚实与善良；趁年轻马上行动。
